data.title: Lionel Messi bids farewell to father who guided his glittering career
data.description: ROSARIO, Argentina - Argentina football icon Lionel Messi bid farewell on Sunday to his father Jorge, the global star's emotional anchor and agent since childhood who passed away following a battle with cancer aged 68.

data.title: Syria says reached deal with Moscow on fate of Russian bases
data.description: DAMASCUS - Syria said on Sunday that it reached a deal with Russia on the fate of its two bases in the country, which Moscow once used to provide military support to ousted leader Bashar al-Assad during the Syrian civil war.

data.title: Hiroshi Nagai brings his tropical dreams to RCB
data.description: River City Bangkok invites everyone to step into a sun-drenched paradise of eternal nostalgia during "Hiroshi Nagai: Summer Dreaming", which is running at RCB Galleria on the 2nd floor, until Sept 4.

data.title: Romance in the air at Sala Sudasiri Sobha
data.description: Turkish cellist Burak Özkan and Portuguese pianist Bernardo Santos will join hands to delight audiences in Bangkok with "The Grand Tango & Romantic Masterpieces", which will take place at Sala Sudasiri Sobha, Lat Phrao 41 yaek 7-2, on Sunday at 4pm.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Aug 10
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Changing landscapes
data.description: The Local Networking Project was launched last year by the Bangkok Art and Culture Centre. The project aims to provide a space for artists from various regions to explore and express their stories through contemporary art.

data.title: Battle Of Fates spin-off House Of Fates  gets the go-ahead from Disney+ Korea
data.description: After Battle Of Fates broke records earlier this year to become the No.1 series premiere of all time on Disney+ Korea, the team behind the smash show are set to return with an exciting new spin-off titled House Of Fates.

data.title: Apec urges businesses to work on their resilience
data.description: Apec business leaders have urged companies to strengthen resilience as geopolitical conflicts, supply-chain disruptions and climate risks create growing uncertainty across the Asia-Pacific economy.

data.title: Action plan for 'open govt' on way
data.description: Thailand is moving to establish its first national action plan for open government, aiming to improve transparency, public participation and access to state information.

data.title: Kurdish PKK criticises Turkey bill on fate of its fighters
data.description: ISTANBUL - Outlawed Kurdish group the PKK on Sunday criticised a proposed Turkish law setting out the fate of its fighters after disarmament, a day before parliament prepares to consider it.

data.title: Thai siblings strike gold, silver
data.description: Thailand's BMX riders delivered a statement of intent for the forthcoming Asian Games in Nagoya, with the Nakpaen brothers claiming gold and silver at the Asian Championships in Malaysia.

data.title: Chinese duo deny Aimsaard sisters Korea Masters glory
data.description: Women's doubles pair Benyapa Aimsaard and Nuntakarn Aimsaard missed out on their first title since July last year after losing in the final of the US$250,000 BWF Korea Masters on Sunday.

data.title: Student charged with Chinese man murder
data.description: CHON BURI: Police arrested a 20-year-old student for allegedly stabbing a Chinese man to death in a room in Sattahip district.

data.title: Political families tied to exam fraud
data.description: Some influential political families are involved in local-government exam fraud, with evidence forwarded to the National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC), says the Interior Ministry.

data.title: When school stops feeling safe
data.description: For two years, a Mathayom 6 student in Khon Kaen went to school fearing what might happen to him.

data.title: Bodies hanging from bridge revive violence in once-calm town in Mexico
data.description: POZOS DE GAMBOA (MEXICO) - Horrific drug violence plagued the Mexican state of Zacatecas for years, until relative calm set in. Then one morning in July this small town woke up to find five bodies dangling from a bridge -- a grim calling card that showed the bloodshed never really left.

data.title: Five dead in new Russia, Ukraine strikes
data.description: KYIV (UKRAINE) - Russian strikes killed two people and wounded dozens across Ukraine overnight Saturday and Sunday, while a Ukrainian drone attack killed three people in Russia's Belgorod region.

data.title: Heavy rain triggers floods in northern provinces
data.description: Heavy rain has caused flooding in Mae Hong Son and Nakhon Phanom, damaging farmland, roads and riverside homes as forecasters warn of more heavy rain and possible flash floods.

data.title: Myanmar keen to revive trade links
data.description: Thailand and Myanmar are seeking to revive border trade and ease barriers, following years of disruption, the Department of Foreign Trade (DoFT) says.

data.title: Durian exports pass 2025  total despite rising costs
data.description: Thailand has exported more than 1.11 million tonnes of durians so far this year, surpassing last year's total despite higher production, transport costs and intensifying competition.

data.title: Govt eyes stronger cyber defences as data leaks raise alarm
data.description: Government agencies will consider adopting multi-factor authentication (MFA) and resetting passwords following data leaks that exposed sensitive information from at least 20 state agencies.

data.title: Parties ready censure motion
data.description: The opposition will file a no-confidence motion against the government in the next parliamentary session, with alleged collusion in the Senate election among the issues it plans to raise.

data.title: Shooter used online guides
data.description: The 14-year-old student who carried out the deadly shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School studied how to use firearms online for one to two years prior to the attack, police say.

data.title: Spikers keep clean record in second leg
data.description: Thailand finished the second leg of the 2026 SEA V Cup in Chiang Mai with a perfect record after defeating Southeast Asian rivals Vietnam 3-0 (25-20, 25-10, 25-15) on Sunday.

data.title: War Elephants top the charts
data.description: Thailand secured top spot in Group B of the Asean Hyundai Cup on Saturday, beating Myanmar 2-0 in Bangkok to book a semi-final meeting with four-time champions Singapore.

data.title: Students, teachers mourn girl killed in Thailand school shooting
data.description: BANGKOK - Dozens of bereaved students, parents and teachers queued at a Buddhist temple in Thailand on Sunday to pray over the body of a 12-year-old girl, one of eight victims of a home and school shooting two days earlier.

data.title: Typhoon Dolphin makes landfall in China after flight cancellations, evacuations
data.description: BEIJING - Typhoon Dolphin made landfall in densely populated eastern China on Sunday, meteorological authorities said, after the storm triggered more than 1,000 flight cancellations, evacuations and a top-level alert.

data.title: Police cite multiple factors in deadly school shooting
data.description: The deadly attack by a student at Debsirin Nonthaburi School appears to have resulted from a combination of factors such as family problems, issues at school, academic pressure, conflicts with friends and exposure to violent online content, a senior police officer said on Sunday.

data.title: Benz driver caught with 'ice' under the bonnet
data.description: SAMUT SONGKHRAM - Police arrested a woman after finding one kilogramme of crystal methamphetamine, aka “ice”, hidden under the bonnet of her Mercedes-Benz and a pistol on the back seat, in Muang district early Sunday morning.

data.title: ONE Championship: Masaaki Noiri promises Siasarani KO next after avenging Liu loss
data.description: Masaaki Noiri has promised to knock out Mohammad Siasarani in the ONE Samurai featherweight kickboxing tournament semi-finals before completing a route back to Superbon and the ONE Championship world title.

data.title: Iran Guards say won't reopen Hormuz without US meeting all Tehran's conditions
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Sunday they would not reopen the Strait of Hormuz, vital to the world economy, until the United States met Tehran's conditions set out the day before, including compensation for war damages.

data.title: Man found shot dead after killing his girlfriend
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - A man was found shot dead outside his home in Muang district of this southern province early Sunday morning, after allegedly killing his girlfriend on Friday.
